features.title: Fast menus
features.description: Shortens the menu's scripted animations and shows images as soon as they are loaded, without the fade.

options.title: Animation speed
options.description: How much faster the menu animations run: 2 makes them twice as short, 1 keeps the sim's speed. Looping animations (loading indicators) keep their pace.

options.title: Images without fade
options.description: Shows images at once instead of fading them in.

features.title: Weather and time bar
features.description: A bar on Free Flight with one-click weather presets and times of day (dawn, day, dusk, night, computed from the sun at the departure airport).

options.title: Remember the last choice
options.description: Applies the last weather, time of day, traffic and multiplayer choice again when the sim starts.

options.title: METAR section
options.description: Shows the real weather (METAR) at the departure airport with its flight category, and the simulated weather when Live is off.

options.title: Traffic section
options.description: Shows buttons for air traffic and multiplayer.

features.title: Mouse wheel on the time
features.description: The mouse wheel over the Flight Conditions widget moves the time: later upwards, earlier downwards. With live weather it moves within the last 24 hours.

options.title: Step
options.description: Time shift for one notch of the wheel.

options.title: Step with Shift
options.description: Time shift for one notch of the wheel while Shift is held.

features.title: Tail number per livery
features.description: Each livery keeps its own tail number: the one you type is applied again whenever that livery is selected.

features.title: Aircraft setup panel
features.description: A panel in the aircraft selection with the variants, the liveries as thumbnails, favourite liveries and the tail number.

options.title: Widen the left column
options.description: Extra width of the left column, in layout units (the screen is 1080 units high; the sim's column is 470 wide). 0 keeps the sim's width. In the gallery's side by side layout the column is 400 units wide instead.

features.title: Aircraft gallery and list
features.description: Replaces the aircraft list with a gallery or a compact list, with favourites per aircraft and per livery, a filter and the sim's sort orders.

options.title: Layout
options.description: How the aircraft selection shows the aircraft and their liveries.

choices.title: Classic
choices.description: The gallery fills the right side; the liveries are small thumbnails in the setup panel.

choices.title: Side by side
choices.description: The aircraft on the left part of the gallery, three per row; the liveries of the current aircraft on the right part, two per row, as large tiles with their name and tail number.

features.title: Favourites on Free Flight
features.description: A Favorites block on Free Flight to pick a favourite aircraft or livery directly, and a record of recently used aircraft.
